title: Desktop Support Technician
job_description:
We are seeking a reliable and hands-on IT Technician to support installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IT, electrical wiring, and audio-visual (AV) systems. The successful candidate will be involved in on-site deployment projects, particularly for education, corporate, and training environments. Diploma in Computer Science/ Information Technology/ Electronic / Electrical or equivalent Minimum 2 years working experience Knowledge of electrical wiring , structured cabling, and safety practices Able to work independently and as part of a team Must be computer literate (Microsoft Excel, Word & PowerPoint and basic graphical software). Possess strong analytical, interpersonal, communication and design skills. Willing to travel and perform on-site work Technical knowledge and experience in Switches, Router and Firewall will be a plus.

Perform Electrical wiring , cabling, and power setup for IT and AV equipment Install, configure, and test audio-visual systems (e.g. displays, projectors, speakers, microphones, interactive panels) Perform regular maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of computer equipment Computer hardware/networking troubleshooting skills Assist in the installation, testing, and commissioning of new systems and equipment Provide technical support and advice to clients Support sales team for product demonstration, training, POC Must be result-orientated and able to work extra hours to meet deadlines.

Annual Leave Medical and Hospitalisation Leave SOCSO EPF EIS Allowance Provided Training Provided Performance Bonus

Electrical Wiring Troubleshooting Network Administration Computer Hardware
